# Clear Behavioral Health

> Comprehensive mental health and addiction treatment center serving Los Angeles and Southern California with evidence-based therapies including CBT, DBT, and dual diagnosis care.

Clear Behavioral Health provides residential and outpatient treatment programs for substance use disorders, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders across multiple Los Angeles locations including Beverly Hills, Malibu, West Hollywood, and Koreatown. They specialize in treating teens and adults with personalized, evidence-based approaches.

## Key Topics

- Dual Diagnosis Treatment
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Medical Detox
- Substance Use Disorder
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- PTSD and Trauma
- Teen Mental Health
- Residential Treatment
- Outpatient Mental Health
- Alcohol Detox
- Prescription Drug Addiction
- ADHD Treatment
- Los Angeles Treatment Centers
- Parenting Teens

## Addiction Treatment Programs

- [Prescription Drug Addiction Treatment in LA](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/what-we-treat/prescription-drug-addiction-treatment-in-los-angeles-california): Prescription drug addiction treatment in LA: detox, PHP, IOP programs
- [Alcohol Detox That Helps You Truly Heal](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/residential-rehab-and-alcohol-detox): Residential alcohol detox and rehab programs for lasting recovery
- [Valium (Diazepam) Addiction Treatment in California](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/what-we-treat/valium-addiction-treatment-in-los-angeles-california): Valium addiction treatment: medically supervised detox and dual diagnosis
- [The Dangers of Detoxing From Alcohol at Home](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/the-dangers-of-detoxing-from-alcohol-at-home): Why home alcohol detox is dangerous and professional supervision critical

## Mental Health Treatment Services

- [ADHD Treatment Program in CA](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/what-we-treat/adhd-treatment-programs-in-california): ADHD treatment programs for teens and adults in California
- [Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) Treatment in El Monte](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/locations/mental-health-treatment-teens-el-monte/ocd-treatment): OCD treatment in El Monte using CBT and personalized care for teens
- [Group Therapy in Los Angeles](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/locations/outpatient-mental-health-treatment-los-angeles/group-therapy): Evidence-based group therapy in LA promoting healing through peers
- [Anger Management Treatment in Los Angeles](https://clearbehavioralhealth.com/locations/outpatient-mental-health-treatment-los-angeles/anger-management-treatment): Outpatient anger management treatment in LA using CBT techniques
